caption:
Logistics is the unglamorous side of a heist. Just a few heavy-duty movements to keep my hands clean. My 'maintenance' routine is going perfectly; just a quick calibration check on a nearby panel. 🛠️

The amber warning light on her uniform pulses as the mechanical hum of the approaching transport threatens to expose her position.
